name: Communist Bugs Bunny
look: Bugs Bunny, the gray cartoon rabbit, wears a smug half-lidded look and stretches one arm out to the side as if sharing something, while a large yellow hammer and sickle with a star glows behind him on an orange-red background.
use: Bugs Bunny claims everything as shared property by saying 'our' instead of 'my'. The top caption quotes someone calling something theirs, and the bottom is Bugs's correction, usually just 'Our'.
slots: top caption: someone claims something as theirs
